event.title: Workshop Digital Selfdefense for Queers in Berlin, Germany

body.p: The FSFE’s Berlin group is participating in a workshop on digital self-defense as part of the 1st Queer-Inclusive Week in Lichtenberg. We’ll show you how to secure your data and explain why Free Software plays such a central role in our privacy and digital autonomy.

The workshop will take place at the Kieztreff Undine at Hagenstraße 57, right next to the Lichtenberg U-Bahn and S-Bahn station. It starts at 5:00 p.m. The workshop will be conducted primarily in German, but we’re happy to answer questions in English as well. Admission is free; the Kieztreff is wheelchair accessible.
